title: User scope and account service login
what: The console's user scope on the account service: the session sealed in the console's cookie and checked per request, sumida's session asked through the server, and which rooms and routes a member may reach.

title: Agent management
what: The agents screen: the agency's catalogue in tabs (general, workers, models, roads, gates, research), the provider by tier model mapping, workers and their settings, read and changed through the agency's routes; the gate order and the nodes stand unavailable.
aliases: 에이전트 관리 창 하단에 여백이 없음. 컨텐츠 페이지 디자인은 항상 하단에 여백을 넣어야함
워커 탭이랑 서쳐 탭에 있는 타이틀
특정워커는 주기적 keepalive 를 완전히 끄는 스위치

title: Agent logs
what: An agent's screen: its run log read by run from the agency's GET /run-log with token chips, what a turn received tagged by kind, file diffs of a job's tool results, and a worker's job line and prompt read from bmo-job.
aliases: 에이전트 챗 페이지 상단에는 사용량 버튼과 별도로 컨텍스트 258K
채팅방이랑 에이전트 세부 내용 말인데 거기에 토큰 사용한거 표시해. 읽기 쓰기 캐시읽기 캐시쓰기말야. Rn Wn CRn CWn 이런식으로.
에이전트 페이지나 채팅페이지별로 에이전트가 대답하는 각 항목 항목마다 '판정' 표시처럼 옆에 붙이라는거
워커페이지에서도 툴콜링이나 토큰 사용량 같은것좀 보여줬으면 하는데 CLI 처럼

title: Agent roles, gates and sampling
what: An agent's role, its gates and its sampling, set from the agents screen and sent to the agency's POST /agent-role, POST /agent-gate and /agent-sampling.
aliases: 게이트 설정은 에이전트마다 할 수 있게 해놔

title: Archive screen (bmo-artifact's bundle)
what: The archive screen is bmo-artifact's console bundle, which the console extends and attaches by its declaration; its pages call bmo-artifact through the console's relay, and its share page opens one document without a session.
aliases: 검색 결과를 열람할 수 있는 페이지
그냥 스태틱 호스팅 느낌으로도 쓸 수 있어야되는데
그냥 이런건 배경 밝게 둬도 될듯

title: Audio playback
what: The console's audio player for sounds in rooms, laid out as a voice message with its waveform as the seek bar; the media route hands on the stretch a player asks for of a file the receiver keeps.

title: Profile pictures
what: Profile pictures on the console: one room's or person's picture read through the Telegram service, the first-letter mark with a colour from identity where none is kept, refreshed on the receiver's change events.
aliases: 이름이 없으면 구분이 안가는 중복된 아이콘 항목들

title: Closing with back
what: Closing what floats over the screen with back, one layer at a time from the top, is bmo-ui's; the console keeps the browser harness its tests check it with.
aliases: 선택모드 전환후 뒤로가기 시 모드취소가 아니라 이전페이지로 가버림
오버레이 닫기 기능처럼 뒤로가기의 구현으로 묶는게

title: Base prompts
what: The base prompts an agent's system prompt is built on, read and changed from the agents screen through the agency's GET and POST /base-prompts.
aliases: 다른 하네스 프롬프트로 바꿀 수 있게
딥시크 하네스 프롬프트로 바꾸고 싶을 수도 있잖아

title: Console mark and icons
what: The console's mark and icons: the mascot's controls drawn by scripts/icons.ts from shared/bmo-controls.ts, the yellow cross pad and three buttons on a rounded mint square; the badge is their silhouette, the login logo the front.

title: Event stream
what: The console's event stream: one relay per tab of the receiver's, bmo-job's and the agency's streams with keep frames and the console's own words, reopened from its cursors, which drives screen refreshes and reconnects.

title: Turn progress display
what: Shows live, on the row where the answer will stand, the current turn of the chat agent or a companion: what it received and is doing now, read off the event stream and the receiver's live picture.

title: Cache siren
what: The cache siren screen: the siren's GET /stats and GET /events at CACHE_SIREN_ADDRESS shown per mode and model, with the five-hour and weekly limits; a request is named only by its row or a runner's directory.
aliases: 나머지는 marquee 되는 모델명 표시가 꽉채우게
현재 캐시사이렌에서 사용량 표기가 현재 공급되고 있는 계정 또는 공급자로 읽지 않는듯 함.

title: The chat agent's names
what: The chat agent's name and label the deployment's settings give, registered once by the app and its server, which the console's name, a room's speaker and the agent's labels are read from.

title: Companions
what: Companions on the console: their settings and reset through the agency, and a companion added to or removed from a room through the receiver, from the agents screen and a room's tools.
aliases: 그리고 반복 패널티나 온도 top_p 같은 조작 가능한 파라미터는 설정할 수 있는 UI 로 넣어줘. 저장하면 새 세션으로 하고
각 파라미터 마다 무슨 용도인지 아주 간결하게 적어줘.
자체모델엔 채팅방에 초기화 버튼 넣어줘 상단메뉴에
모델 설정은 에이전트 관리와 채팅방에 동일하게넣을것

title: Console bundles
what: The console attaches every unit's console bundle by its declaration alone: its screen and words, the service relayed under /api/, its event stream, sockets and notice kinds, with no bundle or service named in code; the relay also hands on a unit the settings name.

title: Calling a unit
what: How the console's server calls a unit and fails: one call per unit at its configured address and token, its refusal said by the pack's sentence for its code, and the four states a screen shows of a unit (checking, slow, failed, connected).

title: Shared settings table
what: The shared settings table the agents screen and the DB screen use: sideways scrolling inside its box, sticky column names, draggable column widths and sections.
aliases: 그 셀 설정값 바꿀 수 있는 드롭다운

title: Database viewer
what: The console's DB screen: the server's own PostgreSQL database read by table or typed query in read-only transactions of a process of its own, killed at its deadline, with row dialogs and credentials withheld.

title: Deployment in the title bar
what: The deployment mark in every title bar: the testbed's progress record read at DEPLOY_PROGRESS_FILE as a running, ended or cut run with its stages and steps, and the deployment's hold read from bmo-job; its popover lists them.

title: Document viewer
what: The document viewer: the docs and top documents of the checkouts DOCUMENT_ROOTS names, read, searched and asked about, fragments switched on the brain, the talk kept in document_talk and answered through the receiver's POST /talks.

title: Choosing several by dragging
what: Choosing several items in a list by a long press and a drag is bmo-ui's; the console keeps the browser harness its tests check it with.

title: Fallback and provider order
what: The provider order and fallback the agency answers on, its Claude accounts, and the models Codex and OpenRouter offer, read and changed through the agency's /fallback routes.
aliases: 각 모델별 OpenRouter 모델 Fallback 설정할 수 있게 하고 등록된 OpenRouter 로 대신 기동하는 모드
현재 활성 공급자및 계정과 사용량 읽는 경로를 리팩토링 필요

title: Focus ring
what: How keyboard focus is shown across the console: one accent focus ring, no ring for a press, fields showing focus on their own edge, and the message bar's focus treatment.

title: One save per form
what: One save per form, fixed at the bottom and off while nothing changed, is bmo-ui's; the console keeps the test that holds its forms to it.

title: Home page
what: The console home page: the receiver's rooms, and the agency's catalogue in groups, the gates among them in the catalogue's order, each with what it is doing and its figures.
aliases: ProgressGroup 을 홈 화면 항목에도 적용

title: Agent prompt box
what: The agent prompt box: launches a runner's work through bmo-job's POST /launch, and on a worker's screen sends words to that worker's session without launching a job.
aliases: 마더 워커 외에 다른 잡 워커들은 개별 채팅 입력창 없음
워커한테 말거는건 봇경우가 아니라 워커한테 프롬프트로 넘겨
게이트 에이전트에 보낸걸 왜 네가 응답하지

title: Judgement display
what: A room line's chips and openings: the gate's judgements and a turn's figures where a unit serves them, what opened a turn read from the receiver's GET /rounds/openings, and the context and token chips.
aliases: 해당 메세지 응답에 대해 소진된 토큰 표시
R2 W6 Wc3.5 Rc2.5 이거 있잖아
턴에 브리핑 붙은건 아이콘으로 하단에 칩 표시했으면 함
매턴 마다 음성브리핑 듣는건 칩 누르면 생성되게 해줘
근데 왜 시간이랑 체크 표시가 메세지랑 한줄로 있던건 분리한거?
보낸 직후 방 대기(5초) 동안에도 판정 망치가 뛰게

title: Keepalive
what: Keeping agents' caches warm: the cache warmer's round and each agent's switch and pause under the consumer KEEPALIVE_CONSUMER names, read and set from the agents screen.

title: Console language pack
what: The console's language pack, client/apps/web/i18n/locales/ko.yaml, and its data file: every phrase the console shows, read by @nuxtjs/i18n on screens and by the shared wording module on the server and in tests.

title: Keeping a list's state
what: Keeps a list's state when going to a detail and back: scroll, choices and the screen kept by its screen key so another region's address changes never rebuild it.
aliases: 뒤로가면 내 마지막 메일리스트 상태가 유지되어야하는데

title: Live status board
what: The live status board: the receiver's live picture of chat turns and folding rooms, bmo-job's recent jobs and the co-worker pool, with stops sent to bmo-job; runs no unit serves stand empty.

title: Async content loading display
what: Skeletons shaped like what will come, only for a first lookup, are bmo-ui's; the console keeps the browser test that checks its screens hold to them (docs/skeleton-loading.md).

title: Login
what: Console login: the console's session and its remember choice, the name and password checked by the account service's sumida session, and the console's own accounts before the account model is in force.

title: Long press
what: The long press read as a right press, cancelled by sliding, scrolling or a second finger, is bmo-ui's; the console keeps the browser harness its tests check it with.

title: Text written in markdown
what: Renders the markdown the console shows (agents' words, logs, items, judgements) with one renderer cleaned by DOMPurify, tables in their own box and centred pictures.
aliases: 아카이브 이미지 첨부는 슬라이드 갤러리로 임베딩해
오른다 내린다 색깔표시도 좀 하고 아이콘도 좀 넣고

title: Member's console
what: What the console shows a signed-in user other than the platform administrator: pages declare whether a member may open them, and a member gets their own shell with the room list as home.

title: Memories screen
what: The memories screen: the brain's memory rows as a table with agent, kind, task, room or person, condition, times and outcome, names read from the agency and the receiver, and a switch to take one down or put it back.

title: Message attachments
what: Images and files in a room: a send's attachment handed to the receiver's POST /say-file once under a send key, a message's files, photo and custom emoji read from the receiver's routes, and the picture viewer walking the room's pictures.

title: Message island
what: The message island, the one place the console tells or asks a person something: a pill at the top centre of the screen showing one notice at a time.

title: Chat attachments and Telegram representations
what: Shows chat attachments: names, sizes and downloads, the video and sound players, and Telegram's static pictures, WEBM stickers and custom emoji where a unit serves them.

title: Model catalogue
what: The model files the deployment's own engines serve, listed and changed from the agents screen through the agency's GET and POST /model-catalogue.
aliases: 무슨 모델들이 있는지도 설정으로 관리할 수 있게

title: Provider model tiers
what: The abstract model tiers and each provider's model for a tier, read and changed through the agency's /model-tiers and the models a provider offers.
aliases: 공급자 목록 매번 빌드 안해도 되게 고칠 수 있어?

title: Motion
what: How things come and go on the console: one set of durations and easings, fades only for what comes and goes on its own, dialogs growing from the control pressed.

title: Number notation
what: Number notation is bmo-ui's; the console keeps the one locale its usage figures count in.

title: Bubble palettes
what: Bubble palettes each account chooses for a room's bubbles apart from its theme, kept in the console's web_palettes table, with the preview drawn in a room's bubbles.

title: Screens of units not yet split
what: The placeholder standing in each screen of a unit that ships no console bundle (code graph, monitor, cards, gates, voice briefing): its entry and route stand, and the page says the feature is not available here.

RDP 연결 및 렌더링 품질 설정
보이스 브리핑 듣고 있을 때 끊기는것좀 어떻게 해야할듯

title: Prompt input box
what: The prompt input box rooms and jobs share (ChatComposer): drafts per screen, the long paste mark, the attachment tray, the reply bar, sending files alone, and words keeping each written line.

title: Push notifications
what: Browser push notifications: a job's question and a room message with their pictures, the subscriptions in web_push_devices signed with the console's keys, and the installed app's manifest and service worker, all under the configured base path.

title: Registered models
what: The registered models the agency's model resource holds, listed, created, changed and removed from the agents screen through its GET and POST /models and PATCH and DELETE /models/{modelKey}.
aliases: 공급자와 모델을 등록할 수 있는 구조로 만들어
주소 등록과 API 키 등록을 할 수 있게 해

title: Room screen
what: The room screen: a room's line read page by page from the receiver's console routes, the owner's words sent through POST /say, controls and live turn progress, kept as one screen per room.
aliases: 마더 채팅창 들어오면 하단에 마더 워커 알림이 늦게 떠서 스크롤이 밑에 더생기는 현상
스크롤이 맨 바닥에 있을 때 새 메세지 올라오면 바닥에 있도록 유지 시켜줘야할듯.
정확히는 내가 직접 보낸 메세지만 보여줘야지
선택 모드를 해제할 때마다 입력창에 포커스가 가서 폰 키보드가 올라온다
제품 이미지도 각기 다른 것들이라서 사진그룹으로 묶어 보내지 않고 개별로 나갔음
선택모드 해제하면 채팅방 스크롤이 바닥으로 감

the top of the newly added item can't go past the top of the screen

선택모드시 상단바가 먼저 나오고 그다음 체크박스가 나오는데
카톡에서 내가 장난으로 보냈던 메세지가 계속 하단에 대기상태로 남아있음.

title: Room statistics
what: A room's session sheet: the receiver's figures for the room and each agent's share and session; an agent's runs and tokens, which no unit counts by room, stand as a dash.
aliases: 채팅방이랑 에이전트 세부 내용 말인데 거기에 토큰 사용한거 표시해. 읽기 쓰기 캐시읽기 캐시쓰기말야. Rn Wn CRn CWn 이런식으로.

title: Work in progress
what: Counts what runs in a room besides its own turn (jobs and searches) as one line under the conversation, opening the log of what runs when pressed.
aliases: 현재 워커 돌아가는거 채팅방 하단에 표시되잖아
work-order-257-stage-0-0-1 이런식으로 뜨는데 좀 포맷팅해서 짧게 표시해
watch 가 무슨 watch 인지 표시안해줌

title: Fitting the screen
what: Fits the console to what is really visible, minus the virtual keyboard and the bands over the screen, and keeps modals and sheets clear of the phone's status and gesture bars.
aliases: 난 화면 켰을 때 섬광탄 터지는걸 싫어한단다

title: Screen measuring tool
what: The screen measuring tool a test uses to check a console screen by numbers rather than a picture: position, spacing, alignment, styles, clipping, contrast and duplicate ids, served beside the development console, and the console of stand-ins the console-driven browser tests drive.

title: Screenshot limit
what: The bounded screenshot a test takes of a screen, captured at one pixel to a CSS pixel and shrunk to a width limit, keeping the smaller of JPEG and PNG.

title: Agent session reset
what: Every session an agent holds and the ask to clear one, read and sent through the agency's GET /sessions and POST /session-reset, with the reset's steps.

title: Shared constants and addresses
what: Shared constants and addresses the console's screens and server read alike: limits, periods, the configured base path, screen addresses and the parsing of item and job addresses.
aliases: 숫자 표기되는 부분들에 thousands separator formatting 적용할 것

title: Sidebar navigation
what: The console's sidebar and shell: the screens, the rooms with unread counts and pinned rooms first, the agents in folding groups, and the search palette.

title: Tab bar and toolbar
what: The shared tab bar, toolbar and view switch: tabs that pin and close, each screen's tab state saved per account in the console's web_tab_states table, and the toolbar's one button shape.

title: Console themes
what: Console themes each account chooses, kept in the console's web_themes table and sent in the page head so the first frame stands in them.

title: Job questions
what: Announces on every screen what a job stopped to ask, answered in one place through bmo-job's POST /question; the list of open questions with their words is served by no unit yet.

title: TODO panel
what: The TODO panel on every page: bmo-job's items in state tabs with counts, filters, the item list, an item's detail and verbs, the queue's holds and pause, read and changed through bmo-job's routes.
aliases: 투두잡에 n번째 시도 라고 표시하는건 좀 바꾸자

title: Item talk
what: The talk about one item in the TODO panel, read and sent through bmo-job's GET and POST /todo-talk; its turns are served by no route yet.

title: Tooltips and items by number
what: Tooltips and an item by its number: the one tooltip for words that say more than they show, the layer that shows any cut line whole, and the item tip read from bmo-job.

title: Console translation parts
what: Cuts a text the console would hand a translator into parts at headings and paragraphs, fits returned parts back into one, and tells a text's language by its letters; no unit serves the console a translator yet.

title: Typefaces
what: The console's typefaces: the interface face (Apple SD Gothic Neo with Pretendard behind it) and the monospace face, carried, served and preloaded by the app.

title: Calls on the other units
what: How the console server calls the agency, bmo-job, the receiver and the brain through the TypeScript clients those units publish, reading each answer into the shape its screen stands on and saying each refusal in the pack.

title: Unread message counts
what: Unread message counts per room: the account's read marks in the console's web_room_reads, counted on the receiver's line past each mark, the account's own words reading the room up to them.
aliases: 좌측 방 목록에 내가 읽지 않은 새 메세지들이 몇개 인지
최신 메세지가 있는 방은 상단으로 올라가잖아

title: Usage display
what: The usage meters and panel: the usage windows, tallies and sessions a unit would serve, which none does yet, so every meter reads as having nothing to say.
aliases: 채팅방이랑 에이전트 세부 내용 말인데 거기에 토큰 사용한거 표시해. 읽기 쓰기 캐시읽기 캐시쓰기말야. Rn Wn CRn CWn 이런식으로.
그리고 토큰사용량 CR CW는 RC WC 로 해줘

title: Settings dialog
what: The settings dialog opened from the user menu, with its sections (account, theme, bubbles, notifications) in one dialog, the account's password and name changed on the account service.

title: User menu
what: The user menu: a dropdown offering the settings dialog, the screen mode (dark until chosen, kept in a cookie so the server draws the first screen in it) and logout.

title: A worker's node
what: The node a worker stands on, sent to the agency's POST /worker/node; the nodes themselves are the node unit's, so a worker stands on this machine alone.

title: Work order panel
what: An item's work order: its plan, stages and tasks read from bmo-job's GET /work-orders, a task's dialog and a builder's result, changes sent to POST /work-order; translation is the gate unit's and stands unavailable.
